ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the Earth is at the center, and there are two dashed circular orbits, inner and outer, around it; satellite a is located on the right side of the inner orbit, satellite b is located on the right side of the outer orbit, and a, b and the Earth's center are on the same straight line and on the same side, indicating that at this moment the two are at the closest distance; satellite c is also on the outer orbit, indicating that b and c are jointly on the outer synchronous orbit. In the figure, the directions of the arrows on the inner and outer orbits are consistent, indicating that the satellites orbit in the same direction. Then reason: a is at a height R from the Earth's surface, and the Earth's radius is R, so a's orbital radius is r_a=2R. The universal gravitational force provides the centripetal force for circular motion, GMm/r_a^2=m n_a^2 r_a, therefore a's angular velocity n_a=√(GM/r_a^3)=√(GM/(8R^3)). b is on the Earth's synchronous orbit, so b's angular velocity is equal to the angular velocity of the Earth's rotation ω. When the two satellites are at the closest distance, they should again be collinear with the Earth's center and located in the same radial direction, that is, the relative angular displacement increases by another 2π. Since a is on the relatively inner orbit, its angular velocity is larger, and the relative angular velocity is n_a-ω=√(GM/(8R^3))-ω. Therefore the required time t=2π/(√(GM/(8R^3))-ω).

method.method_draft: 先读图：地球在中心，a 在较内侧圆轨道的右侧，b 在较外侧圆轨道的右侧，a、b 与地心在同一直线上，表示此刻二者相距最近；c 也在外侧轨道上，说明外侧轨道是 b、c 共同的同步轨道。再读题：a 离地表高度为 R，地球半径为 R，所以 a 的轨道半径 r_a=2R；b 在同步轨道上，所以其角速度等于地球自转角速度 ω。用圆周轨道万有引力提供向心力，得 a 的角速度 n_a=√(GM/r_a^3)=√(GM/(8R^3))。两颗同向绕行的卫星再次相距最近，就是再次与地心共线且在同一径向方向上，即相对转过 2π；相对角速度为 n_a-ω。因此 t=2π/(√(GM/(8R^3))-ω)。
